shortDescription: Allows the add/delete of Firewall Policies on Packages in FortiManager.

options.name: action
options.description: Policy action (allow/deny/ipsec). choice | deny | Blocks sessions that match the firewall policy. choice | accept | Allows session that match the firewall policy. choice | ipsec | Firewall policy becomes a policy-based IPsec VPN policy.

options.name: adom
options.description: The ADOM the configuration should belong to.

options.name: app_category
options.description: Application category ID list.

options.name: app_group
options.description: Application group names.

options.name: application
options.description: Application ID list.

options.name: application_list
options.description: Name of an existing Application list.

options.name: auth_cert
options.description: HTTPS server certificate for policy authentication.

options.name: auth_path
options.description: Enable/disable authentication-based routing. choice | disable | Disable authentication-based routing. choice | enable | Enable authentication-based routing.

options.name: auth_redirect_addr
options.description: HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect address for firewall authentication.

options.name: auto_asic_offload
options.description: Enable/disable offloading security profile processing to CP processors. choice | disable | Disable ASIC offloading. choice | enable | Enable auto ASIC offloading.

options.name: av_profile
options.description: Name of an existing Antivirus profile.

options.name: block_notification
options.description: Enable/disable block notification. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: captive_portal_exempt
options.description: Enable to exempt some users from the captive portal. choice | disable | Disable exemption of captive portal. choice | enable | Enable exemption of captive portal.

options.name: capture_packet
options.description: Enable/disable capture packets. choice | disable | Disable capture packets. choice | enable | Enable capture packets.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comment.

options.name: custom_log_fields
options.description: Custom fields to append to log messages for this policy.

options.name: delay_tcp_npu_session
options.description: Enable TCP NPU session delay to guarantee packet order of 3-way handshake. choice | disable | Disable TCP NPU session delay in order to guarantee packet order of 3-way handshake. choice | enable | Enable TCP NPU session delay in order to guarantee packet order of 3-way handshake.

options.name: devices
options.description: Names of devices or device groups that can be matched by the policy.

options.name: diffserv_forward
options.description: Enable to change packet's DiffServ values to the specified diffservcode-forward value. choice | disable | Disable WAN optimization. choice | enable | Enable WAN optimization.

options.name: diffserv_reverse
options.description: Enable to change packet's reverse (reply) DiffServ values to the specified diffservcode-rev value. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: diffservcode_forward
options.description: Change packet's DiffServ to this value.

options.name: diffservcode_rev
options.description: Change packet's reverse (reply) DiffServ to this value.

options.name: disclaimer
options.description: Enable/disable user authentication disclaimer. choice | disable | Disable user authentication disclaimer. choice | enable | Enable user authentication disclaimer.

options.name: dlp_sensor
options.description: Name of an existing DLP sensor.

options.name: dnsfilter_profile
options.description: Name of an existing DNS filter profile.

options.name: dscp_match
options.description: Enable DSCP check. choice | disable | Disable DSCP check. choice | enable | Enable DSCP check.

options.name: dscp_negate
options.description: Enable negated DSCP match. choice | disable | Disable DSCP negate. choice | enable | Enable DSCP negate.

options.name: dscp_value
options.description: DSCP value.

options.name: dsri
options.description: Enable DSRI to ignore HTTP server responses. choice | disable | Disable DSRI. choice | enable | Enable DSRI.

options.name: dstaddr
options.description: Destination address and address group names.

options.name: dstaddr_negate
options.description: When enabled dstaddr specifies what the destination address must NOT be. choice | disable | Disable destination address negate. choice | enable | Enable destination address negate.

options.name: dstintf
options.description: Outgoing (egress) interface.

options.name: fail_on_missing_dependency
options.description: Normal behavior is to "skip" tasks that fail dependency checks, so other tasks can run. If set to "enabled" if a failed dependency check happeens, Ansible will exit as with failure instead of skip.

options.name: firewall_session_dirty
options.description: How to handle sessions if the configuration of this firewall policy changes. choice | check-all | Flush all current sessions accepted by this policy. choice | check-new | Continue to allow sessions already accepted by this policy.

options.name: fixedport
options.description: Enable to prevent source NAT from changing a session's source port. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: fsso
options.description: Enable/disable Fortinet Single Sign-On. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: fsso_agent_for_ntlm
options.description: FSSO agent to use for NTLM authentication.

options.name: global_label
options.description: Label for the policy that appears when the GUI is in Global View mode.

options.name: groups
options.description: Names of user groups that can authenticate with this policy.

options.name: gtp_profile
options.description: GTP profile.

options.name: icap_profile
options.description: Name of an existing ICAP profile.

options.name: identity_based_route
options.description: Name of identity-based routing rule.

options.name: inbound
options.description: Policy-based IPsec VPN |  only traffic from the remote network can initiate a VPN. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: internet_service
options.description: Enable/disable use of Internet Services for this policy. If enabled, dstaddr and service are not used. choice | disable | Disable use of Internet Services in policy. choice | enable | Enable use of Internet Services in policy.

options.name: internet_service_custom
options.description: Custom Internet Service name.

options.name: internet_service_id
options.description: Internet Service ID.

options.name: internet_service_negate
options.description: When enabled internet-service specifies what the service must NOT be. choice | disable | Disable negated Internet Service match. choice | enable | Enable negated Internet Service match.

options.name: internet_service_src
options.description: Enable/disable use of Internet Services in source for this policy. If enabled, source address is not used. choice | disable | Disable use of Internet Services source in policy. choice | enable | Enable use of Internet Services source in policy.

options.name: internet_service_src_custom
options.description: Custom Internet Service source name.

options.name: internet_service_src_id
options.description: Internet Service source ID.

options.name: internet_service_src_negate
options.description: When enabled internet-service-src specifies what the service must NOT be. choice | disable | Disable negated Internet Service source match. choice | enable | Enable negated Internet Service source match.

options.name: ippool
options.description: Enable to use IP Pools for source NAT. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: ips_sensor
options.description: Name of an existing IPS sensor.

options.name: label
options.description: Label for the policy that appears when the GUI is in Section View mode.

options.name: learning_mode
options.description: Enable to allow everything, but log all of the meaningful data for security information gathering. choice | disable | Disable learning mode in firewall policy. choice | enable | Enable learning mode in firewall policy.

options.name: logtraffic
options.description: Enable or disable logging. Log all sessions or security profile sessions. choice | disable | Disable all logging for this policy. choice | all | Log all sessions accepted or denied by this policy. choice | utm | Log traffic that has a security profile applied to it.

options.name: logtraffic_start
options.description: Record logs when a session starts and ends. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: match_vip
options.description: Enable to match packets that have had their destination addresses changed by a VIP. choice | disable | Do not match DNATed packet. choice | enable | Match DNATed packet.

options.name: mms_profile
options.description: Name of an existing MMS profile.

options.name: mode
options.description: Sets one of three modes for managing the object. Allows use of soft-adds instead of overwriting existing values

options.name: name
options.description: Policy name.

options.name: nat
options.description: Enable/disable source NAT. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: natinbound
options.description: Policy-based IPsec VPN |  apply destination NAT to inbound traffic. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: natip
options.description: Policy-based IPsec VPN |  source NAT IP address for outgoing traffic.

options.name: natoutbound
options.description: Policy-based IPsec VPN |  apply source NAT to outbound traffic. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: np_acceleration
options.description: Enable/disable UTM Network Processor acceleration. choice | disable | Disable UTM Network Processor acceleration. choice | enable | Enable UTM Network Processor acceleration.

options.name: ntlm
options.description: Enable/disable NTLM authentication. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: ntlm_enabled_browsers
options.description: HTTP-User-Agent value of supported browsers.

options.name: ntlm_guest
options.description: Enable/disable NTLM guest user access. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: outbound
options.description: Policy-based IPsec VPN |  only traffic from the internal network can initiate a VPN. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: package_name
options.description: The policy package you want to modify

options.name: per_ip_shaper
options.description: Per-IP traffic shaper.

options.name: permit_any_host
options.description: Accept UDP packets from any host. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: permit_stun_host
options.description: Accept UDP packets from any Session Traversal Utilities for NAT (STUN) host. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: policyid
options.description: Policy ID.

options.name: poolname
options.description: IP Pool names.

options.name: profile_group
options.description: Name of profile group.

options.name: profile_protocol_options
options.description: Name of an existing Protocol options profile.

options.name: profile_type
options.description: Determine whether the firewall policy allows security profile groups or single profiles only. choice | single | Do not allow security profile groups. choice | group | Allow security profile groups.

options.name: radius_mac_auth_bypass
options.description: Enable MAC authentication bypass. The bypassed MAC address must be received from RADIUS server. choice | disable | Disable MAC authentication bypass. choice | enable | Enable MAC authentication bypass.

options.name: redirect_url
options.description: URL users are directed to after seeing and accepting the disclaimer or authenticating.

options.name: replacemsg_override_group
options.description: Override the default replacement message group for this policy.

options.name: rsso
options.description: Enable/disable RADIUS single sign-on (RSSO). choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: rtp_addr
options.description: Address names if this is an RTP NAT policy.

options.name: rtp_nat
options.description: Enable Real Time Protocol (RTP) NAT. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: scan_botnet_connections
options.description: Block or monitor connections to Botnet servers or disable Botnet scanning. choice | disable | Do not scan connections to botnet servers. choice | block | Block connections to botnet servers. choice | monitor | Log connections to botnet servers.

options.name: schedule
options.description: Schedule name.

options.name: schedule_timeout
options.description: Enable to force current sessions to end when the schedule object times out. choice | disable | Disable schedule timeout. choice | enable | Enable schedule timeout.

options.name: send_deny_packet
options.description: Enable to send a reply when a session is denied or blocked by a firewall policy. choice | disable | Disable deny-packet sending. choice | enable | Enable deny-packet sending.

options.name: service
options.description: Service and service group names.

options.name: service_negate
options.description: When enabled service specifies what the service must NOT be. choice | disable | Disable negated service match. choice | enable | Enable negated service match.

options.name: session_ttl
options.description: TTL in seconds for sessions accepted by this policy (0 means use the system default session TTL).

options.name: spamfilter_profile
options.description: Name of an existing Spam filter profile.

options.name: srcaddr
options.description: Source address and address group names.

options.name: srcaddr_negate
options.description: When enabled srcaddr specifies what the source address must NOT be. choice | disable | Disable source address negate. choice | enable | Enable source address negate.

options.name: srcintf
options.description: Incoming (ingress) interface.

options.name: ssh_filter_profile
options.description: Name of an existing SSH filter profile.

options.name: ssl_mirror
options.description: Enable to copy decrypted SSL traffic to a FortiGate interface (called SSL mirroring). choice | disable | Disable SSL mirror. choice | enable | Enable SSL mirror.

options.name: ssl_mirror_intf
options.description: SSL mirror interface name.

options.name: ssl_ssh_profile
options.description: Name of an existing SSL SSH profile.

options.name: status
options.description: Enable or disable this policy. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: tcp_mss_receiver
options.description: Receiver TCP maximum segment size (MSS).

options.name: tcp_mss_sender
options.description: Sender TCP maximum segment size (MSS).

options.name: tcp_session_without_syn
options.description: Enable/disable creation of TCP session without SYN flag. choice | all | Enable TCP session without SYN. choice | data-only | Enable TCP session data only. choice | disable | Disable TCP session without SYN.

options.name: timeout_send_rst
options.description: Enable/disable sending RST packets when TCP sessions expire. choice | disable | Disable sending of RST packet upon TCP session expiration. choice | enable | Enable sending of RST packet upon TCP session expiration.

options.name: traffic_shaper
options.description: Traffic shaper.

options.name: traffic_shaper_reverse
options.description: Reverse traffic shaper.

options.name: url_category
options.description: URL category ID list.

options.name: users
options.description: Names of individual users that can authenticate with this policy.

options.name: utm_status
options.description: Enable to add one or more security profiles (AV, IPS, etc.) to the firewall policy. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: vlan_cos_fwd
options.description: VLAN forward direction user priority | 255 passthrough, 0 lowest, 7 highest.

options.name: vlan_cos_rev
options.description: VLAN reverse direction user priority | 255 passthrough, 0 lowest, 7 highest..

options.name: vlan_filter
options.description: Set VLAN filters.

options.name: voip_profile
options.description: Name of an existing VoIP profile.

options.name: waf_profile
options.description: Name of an existing Web application firewall profile.

options.name: wanopt
options.description: Enable/disable WAN optimization. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: wanopt_detection
options.description: WAN optimization auto-detection mode. choice | active | Active WAN optimization peer auto-detection. choice | passive | Passive WAN optimization peer auto-detection. choice | off | Turn off WAN optimization peer auto-detection.

options.description: WAN optimization passive mode options. options.description: WAN optimization peer.

options.description: WAN optimization profile.

options.name: wccp
options.description: Enable/disable forwarding traffic matching this policy to a configured WCCP server. choice | disable | Disable WCCP setting. choice | enable | Enable WCCP setting.

options.name: webcache
options.description: Enable/disable web cache. choice | disable | Disable setting. choice | enable | Enable setting.

options.name: webcache_https
options.description: Enable/disable web cache for HTTPS. choice | disable | Disable web cache for HTTPS. choice | enable | Enable web cache for HTTPS.

options.name: webfilter_profile
options.description: Name of an existing Web filter profile.
